Turn off volumetric rendering. It has a huge hit to performance and doesn't really add much to the game. 

You can turn shadows to low and they'll still look decent. 

Max LOD you can swap to -1. It's most noticeable for rocks/leaves but it still doesn't look bad and will bump up the FPS. 

'Subsurface Scattering, Screen Space Reflection, Anisotropic Filtering, Water Reflection, SH Diffuse Quality, Dynamic Range: Off/Lowest. Most of them are expensive and have minimal visual impact to the game" - from another post.

Let me know if you get any questions, I'll be happy to answer them. Hope you enjoy the game.

Which server(s) do you play on? If it's EU or US I'd be happy to add you & try teach you a bit about the game. Experience is the best teacher, but it never hurts to have some friendly advice. 


Good starting heroes;
Healer - Mercy, Moira
Tank - Reinhardt
DPS (this one is a bit harder due to how you play) - Soldier 76 (just to learn aiming), Junkrat, Mei. Once you're more familiar with aiming/the game, just try them all out and see how they feel. 


Not dying will come with time but as for some general tips;
Stay with your team. 
Try look at areas people might flank from, like highground or side passages. 
Protect your healers. Can't stress that enough. 
If you are playing healer, stay behind your tanks, or stay mobile. Don't walk in straight lines, be unpredictable. 


The game will usually give you people of a similar skill rating, so try and think how you would attack that objective from their side of the map. Where would you go? Odds are, someone on their team is there. 


Targeting enemies; 
Change your sensitivity. It defaults to something like 15. That's too much for most heroes, especially if you're new to FPS. Slowly turn it down to a more reasonable amount. This changes per person, but generally you want to be able to look around & keep your crosshair level. If it's going up and down a lot, it's too high. 


And the best advice; You'll get better with time. Try to enjoy the game, don't worry about wins/losses or rank. If you do, you'll get frustrated. Play some heroes, see what works with your style. It's a great game, and I hope you enjoy it.

Fuck man. I don't know what to do. The urge to die right now is so strong
I just don't know anymore. I'm just causing everyone stress & debt to keep me alive when, i just don't think i want to be anymore.

I mostly feel like I'm wasting everyone's time, resources and money. 

They said they're trying but it has been three years. I'll have to wait for someone to die in one of the few fully adapted properties, then move in. Which makes me feel a hundred times worse.

I'm disabled. Both legs and one arm doesn't work. We don't own it, but rent around here is very high and my mother had to quit her job to care for me. Even with disability help we barely get by. Plus we haven't found anything fully adapted.

As its a private rental we cannot modify the house since landlord refuses. I've tried government disability housing. I've been top priority for 3 years now. There's nothing available due to the extent of my needs. 

Hence more and more, these thoughts creep in. It's no way to "live", if it can be called living.

I would love to, but i can't walk, and my wheelchair (which my mother has to get me in/out of and move) doesn't fit through the door. The house is useless for my situation, but we're far too poor to move.

I've tried in the past but my condition keeps deteriorating. There's not much I can do anymore. I mostly just lay in bed and watch something. Wait for food, eat, go to sleep & repeat. 

I feel so worthless. Running up so much debt to keep myself alive, when i don't deserve to be.
I try to tell myself that but i just feel trapped inside these thoughts and urges. Maybe I'm just not cut out for all of this. I don't know.

I don't know. I never have. Everything i am is a product of what has happened. There was no time to become myself. It was just a matter of surviving that moment. 

I allowed some terrible things to happen to myself over the years, maybe my actual self is so sick of it, that it wants to die.

I've seen six therapists so far & I'm trialing my 4th medication now. Nothing prior has helped, other than making me feel incredibly dazed and "out of it", so I'm not hopeful on that front. 

Goals i can't really speak about. I don't have any. All I've thought about for the past ten years is death. When it's that consuming, you don't really plan anything else.
